body:
Parent and mandatory full specification: #528. Raised/recorded: 2026-10-02 (America/Los_Angeles); user design finalized the same date. Structural engineering only, no factual research/population. Read the parent in full; it records all definitions, rejected shortcuts, UI/preservation/time/research-gate requirements. Claim only when ready and dependencies closed. Use isolated engineering/<job-id> from fresh main, preserve other workers, one issue per focused PR, serialized squash merge and one designated publisher. Normally one PR; split additional scope before exceeding the stated 1–3-PR budget. Shared registrar/schema integration must be coordinated; do not independently rebuild or replace the existing platform.

Implement the minimal reusable extension needed by the domain children: political-entity attributes; typed location numeric observations with units/measurement metadata; stable feature/outbreak/port identities and dated location links; controlled registry seams. Reuse current entities, sources, relationships and evidence semantics wherever compatible rather than build seven isolated databases.

Acceptance:
- Versioned declarative field/type/metric definitions distinguish entity-level government from location measures and linked features.
- Preserve existing import/read/export schemas, immutable migrations, claims/retirements, source hashes and date/priority rules. Forward migration and compatible optional API capabilities on supported storage adapters.
- Numeric observation metadata can carry benchmark/PPP scope, household scale/cohort, observation period, original values, provenance/derivation input IDs and uncertainty. Do not implement domain-specific GDP/mortality algorithms here.
- Contracts distinguish unknown, unresolved, known zero/false and supported estimate/reference/example. No modern-to-ancient promotion.
- Safe extension points let domain workers add their modules without rewriting shared core registrars concurrently; document subsystem boundaries and registration procedure.
- Read/import/export/snapshot contract fixtures verify old consumers and preserved source data, server/static parity and dates; no live factual imports or grid/footprint changes.
- Produce concrete migration/import/API compatibility notes and a module integration handover for the dependent workers. Structural baseline works without any new factual records.

Implementation coordination: Establish extension seams first; feature children wait for this contract.

title: Extend dated observation and feature contracts for the agreed atlas attributes
